title: Tests share a process-global SQLite singleton, so pass depends on test order + cleanup
evidence: db.go:12 initDB() short-circuits when db!=nil, so setupTestDB()'s BOOKAPI_DB is ignored after the first call; router_test.go:76 TestCRUD asserts len(list)==1 and relies on its own DELETE to leave the shared in-memory DB empty for TestListByAuthor (router_test.go:105 expects 2)
suggestion: Reset the DB per test (drop/recreate table or open a fresh :memory: handle) so tests are order-independent
